messages.discord.connection.auth-help: Use a Discord Bot Token. This app sends the Bot prefix. The bot must belong to every server you want to read.
messages.discord.guide.oauth-note: Discord OAuth2 authorizes users. The Molis Work connector for server data uses a Bot Token and does not yet support OAuth.
messages.discord.guide.token-note: Create a bot in the Developer Portal, add it to the target server, then paste the Bot Token.
messages.discord.oauth.note: User OAuth can read the identity and joined servers. A separate bot grant provides message access.
